module.purpose: Defines the Fiber node data structure and factory functions that create and clone Fibers for React's reconciler. Implements double-buffering and type-based fiber creation.
module.summary: This module is the core factory for React's Fiber objects. It provides a constructor-style function (FiberNode) and an object-literal factory (createFiberImplObject) selected via feature flag. It exposes many specialized creators (createFiberFromElement, createFiberFromText, createFiberFromPortal, etc.) that map React element types to WorkTag-specific fibers. It also implements createWorkInProgress and resetWorkInProgress which clone or reset fibers for the alternating tree used during rendering. Dev-only checks handle bad Map polyfills and invalid element types by producing a Throw fiber.
module.businessContext: Part of React's internal reconciliation engine. If this breaks, React cannot build or update component trees, causing complete renderer failure.

detail.signature: function FiberNode(this: $FlowFixMe, tag: WorkTag, pendingProps: mixed, key: ReactKey, mode: TypeOfMode)
preconditions: Must be invoked with 'new' to establish the 'this' binding as a fresh object
tag must be a valid WorkTag value

key must be a ReactKey (string or numeric)
mode must be a valid TypeOfMode bitmask
postconditions: this.tag is set to the tag argument
this.key is set to the key argument
this.pendingProps is set to the pendingProps argument
this.mode is set to the mode argument
this.elementType, this.type, this.stateNode are set to null
this.return, this.child, this.sibling are set to null
this.index is set to 0
this.ref, this.refCleanup are set to null
this.memoizedProps, this.updateQueue, this.memoizedState, this.dependencies are set to null

detail.name: shouldConstruct
detail.signature: function shouldConstruct(Component: Function)
preconditions: Component must be a callable function or function-like object
postconditions: Returns true only when Component has a prototype object whose isReactComponent property is truthy

Function whose prototype is not an object → returns false
Function whose prototype.isReactComponent is falsy or undefined → returns false
Function whose prototype.isReactComponent is truthy → returns true

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns false (no throw) for any non-prototype-bearing input

detail.name: createFiberFromTypeAndProps
detail.signature: export function createFiberFromTypeAndProps(type: any, key: ReactKey, pendingProps: any, owner: null | ReactComponentInfo | Fiber, mode: TypeOfMode, lanes: Lanes): Fiber
preconditions: The `type` argument must be a valid React element type (function, string, or object with a recognized $$typeof).
postconditions: Returns a newly created Fiber node with the correct tag and associated props, mode, and lanes.
For known React special types (activity, fragment, profiler, etc.), delegates to the corresponding specialized creator function.
invariants: In development mode, the type is resolved for hot reloading before inspection.
The function tag is initialized to FunctionComponent and potentially updated based on whether the resolved type should construct or is a host component.
edgeCases: If resolvedType is a function, checks shouldConstruct to decide between FunctionComponent and ClassComponent.
If resolvedType is a string, determines host component tagging based on feature flags (supportsResources, supportsSingletons).
For object types with $$typeof, handles various React internal symbols including context, forwardRef, memo, etc.
Unsupported $$typeof values fall through to default handling.
